title: Shared Inbox
description: Assign and work threads from shared mailboxes. Accepted is not the same as delivered.

reconnect.title: Mailbox reconnect required
reconnect.description: {count} mailbox(es) lost connection — sync and reply sending are paused: {names}

collision.newInbound: A new reply arrived while you were viewing. Please review the latest content.
collision.teammateReply: A teammate sent a reply. Please review the latest content.

message.downloadFailed: Could not get an attachment download URL
message.acceptedNotDelivered: Accepted is not a delivery or read confirmation
message.unknownInvestigate: Outcome unknown — needs reconciliation in operations; do not resend

review.title: Review classification
review.description: Model suggestions are kept separate from human reviews. Classifying as unsubscribe request safely pauses follow-up sending.
review.suppressionHint: If this is an unsubscribe request, register a suppression to stop follow-up sending.

reply.title: Reply draft
reply.toInferred: Based on the last inbound message — the server confirms the actual recipient
reply.createdDescription: Submission and sending continue in the sending flow (freeze → review → submit).
reply.acceptedNotDelivered: After submission, 'accepted' means the provider accepted it — not that it was delivered or read.
reply.blockedReconnect: You cannot create drafts until the mailbox is reconnected.
reply.blockedCollision: Please review the new messages first.
reply.blockedForbidden: You do not have compose permission for this mailbox.
reply.blockedNoInbound: There is no inbound message to reply to.

errors.title: Could not complete the action
errors.mailboxDenied: You do not have access to this mailbox.
errors.agentSendForbidden: Agents cannot send directly. Use the approval-request path.
errors.replyContextChanged: A new reply arrived while you were writing. Review the latest content and write again.
errors.replyAlreadySubmitted: Another reply was already submitted. Refreshing the thread.
errors.recipientSuppressed: This address is suppressed. Do not work around it.
errors.emergencyStop: The workspace is in emergency stop. Submissions are paused until explicitly resumed.
errors.versionMismatch: Someone changed it first. Compare with the latest values.
errors.versionPrecondition: The change was rejected because version info was missing. Refresh and try again.
errors.idempotencyReused: A different request with the same key was detected. Check the existing operation.
errors.requestInProgress: The same request is being processed. Do not create duplicates.
errors.reauthRequired: Mailbox re-authentication is required. Notify the connection admin.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again later.

empty.title: No threads to work on
empty.description: New replies will appear here. Mailbox connection warnings show as a top banner.
